messages:
alex_m: Quick heads-up — targeting a small UX hotfix rollout (console v1.2.3) today at 16:00 PT. Will be a staggered release (canary -> wide). Need someone to own CDN invalidation + quick smoke checks.

maria_p: I can own smoke. Plan to run login, org-switch, recent-activity, and saved searches. Will do smoke at canary and after wide.

samg: I can do CDN invalidation & edge priming. Using the usual CloudFront invalidation. I'll queue it right after canary success.

jin-ux: FYI the change touches the /console/settings and the top-nav rendering — keeping rollout small in case of layout regressions. Please watch for header overlap on mobile.

harpreet: I'll be reachable for rollback windows. Rollback tag is `v1.2.2` (ready). If we need to revert, I'll flip traffic and revert canary slot first.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler: Release window confirmed: 2025-06-12 16:00 PT -> canary 10% for 10m -> 50% 5m -> wide. Notifications will be posted to #eng-releases.

samg: Invalidation command I'll run after canary warm: 
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E12ABC34D5 --paths "/static/js/*" "/static/css/*"
```
I'll also POST to the edge-priming webhook: `https://edge-prime.internal/reap` with payload {slot: "canary"}.

alex_m: Maria, when you do smoke, please paste a tiny checklist here (pass/fail) so we have an audit trail. Also call out any visual regressions.

maria_p: Will do. Quick checklist I'll report: 
- login: ok
- org-switch: ok
- settings load: ok
- top-nav mobile: visual check -> FAIL (overlap on iPhone SE)

alex_m: Good catch — Jin, can you check CSS patch? If quick fix possible, we can try hotpatch during the 50% window; otherwise roll back.

jin-ux: I have a one-line fix (scoped padding tweak). Can ship as hotpatch if we keep canary at 10% longer (~15m) to validate. Not ideal but feasible.

harpreet: If we extend canary, I need confirmation from infra that autoscaling/capacity are ok for +5-10m. Sam, can you hold wide until we confirm?

samg: Yep, holding wide. Will only run invalidation after we say go.

alex_m: Decision: hold at 10% for extra 15m; Jin will push hotpatch to canary slot only, Maria will re-smoke mobile, Sam holds invalidation/wide until pass. If smoke passes, we proceed with invalidation + wide. If fail, rollback to `v1.2.2`.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary extended to 25m by request of @alex_m. Notifications sent.

maria_p: Will re-check as soon as hotpatch live and report results here. :thumbsup:

alex_m: Thanks all. Please ping when hotpatch is live and when invalidation runs. I'll update the release ticket with the timeline.
